description:
Issue summary: Request to provision an ephemeral pool of SaaS seats and one vendor-managed license for AcuData researchers to run a 2-week pilot against a sandboxed Redwood environment.

Impact: Without seats the pilot is blocked; requested start date 2026-03-18 to align with partner availability. No production tokens or customer data should be exposed.

Request details:
- 12 researcher seats (browser-based UI) for 14 days
- 2 service account seats for CI/integration to run automated evals
- Temporary SCIM mapping OR invitation flow for external emails (acudata.org)
- BYOK option considered but vendor says not required for short pilot

Background: Research team (AI Research) is collaborating with AcuData on privacy-preserving evals. Partner will run their evaluation suite against a sandbox cluster in us-east to validate model throughput and latency under private data constraints. Procurement and Security need to approve short-lived access and confirm DPA.

Steps already taken:
- Research lead (Maya Lin) requested seats and provided collaborator list (attached in Confluence).
- Security pre-check completed (initial flag for EU data residency — partner has EU-based researchers).
- Procurement reached out to vendor contact (AcuData sales) for trial pricing and DPA template.

Open questions / blockers:
- Legal needs to approve DPA language for academic data processing.
- Security wants confirmation of sandbox network isolation and logging retention settings.
- Billing requires a pro forma invoice or PO for provisional charge coding.
acceptance_criteria: 12 researcher seats provisioned to acu.org emails with invitation link and expiration set to 2026-04-01
2 service account credentials created and scoped to sandbox-only APIs
SCIM or invitation flow documented and tested end-to-end
DPA signed or documented legal approval obtained
Billing code (cost center) assigned and provisional invoice stored
steps_to_provision: Confirm final collaborator email list with Maya Lin
Open vendor trial agreement and request DPA from AcuData sales
Create ephemeral seat pool in Okta/SCIM (group: acu-research-pilot) with 14-day TTL
Provision sandbox API keys with read-only logging retention of 30 days and cross-account isolation
Tag costs to cost center 410-ML-Research and request PO if needed
